name: B10-0436/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the pilot project on European Schools Alliances
part_text:
The European Parliament welcomes a new European Union pilot scheme to help schools in different countries work together more closely, beyond short one-off projects. It asks the Commission to make citizenship education, media literacy and critical thinking part of the scheme, to include schools with fewer resources and pupils with fewer opportunities, to keep paperwork light, and to set clear rules for checking results. The Parliament also wants to be kept informed as the scheme is prepared and run. This is a set of requests, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament asks the Commission to shape the pilot this way.
- **Who it affects:** Schools, teachers and pupils across the EU, especially those with fewer resources.
- **What happens next:** The Commission prepares and runs the pilot and reports back to the Parliament.
